2609.20612.title: What Does Privileged Information Add to On-Policy Self-Distillation?
2609.20612.paper_summary: On-policy self-distillation (OPSD) lets a language model learn from a frozen copy of itself that sees an answer or a worked solution. Giving the teacher this extra information seems to offer the student more to learn, but how much does it add beyond distillation itself? To isolate that contribution, we construct AMPLE-Math, a reusable suite of 5,319 mathematical problems with six reasoning views that share the same answer, and compare each view with matched reference-free distillation. With a thinking-enabled teacher supervising direct-response rollouts, reference-free distillation accounts for much of Qwen3-1.7B's improvement under thinking-enabled evaluation, both in domain and on external benchmarks. Evidence for an additional reference benefit is modest in Qwen, strongest for a polished solution, whereas complete traces add two percentage points in SmolLM3-3B at step 50. These benefits depend on the student being trained. At the same checkpoint, replacing short direct-response rollouts with long thinking-enabled rollouts turns gains into losses in both families while the problems, references, and evaluation stay fixed. Teacher profiles and matched loss interventions in Qwen further show that changing token-level supervision can leave student behavior largely unchanged. Together, these findings suggest that OPSD can improve access to existing reasoning capabilities through parameters shared by direct-response and thinking-enabled inference. The value of a privileged reference is what it adds to this cross-mode transfer, not how much of the solution it reveals.
2609.20612.paper_summary_zh: 在政策自蒸餾（OPSD）中，語言模型可以從一個冷凍的自身副本中學習，該副本能夠看到答案或已解決的方案。給予教師這些額外的信息似乎能為學生提供更多的學習內容，但這在蒸餾本身之外究竟增加了多少呢？為了隔離這一貢獻，我們構建了AMPLE-Math，一個可重用的包含5,319個數學問題的套件，這些問題有六種推理視角，共享相同的答案，並將每種視角與匹配的無參考蒸餾進行比較。在一位思考啟用的教師監督下，直接響應的展開，無參考蒸餾在思考啟用評估中解釋了Qwen3-1.7B的很大一部分改進，無論是在領域內還是在外部基準上。對於額外參考效益的證據在Qwen中是適度的，對於精練的解決方案最為強烈，而在第50步時，完整的追蹤在SmolLM3-3B中增加了兩個百分點。這些益處取決於正在訓練的學生。在同一檢查點上，用長的思考啟用展開替換短的直接響應展開，會使兩個家族的增益變成損失，而問題、參考和評估保持不變。Qwen中的教師輪廓和匹配的損失干預進一步顯示，改變令牌級別的監督可以使學生行為基本保持不變。總的來說，這些發現表明，OPSD可以通過直接響應和思考啟用推理共享的參數來改善對現有推理能力的訪問。特權參考的價值在於它對這種跨模式轉移的增益，而不是它揭示了多少解決方案。
